rationale: Near-bus 3-phase fault (0.2 km) yields max I_3ph = 9.30 kA; remote-end 2-phase fault (8.0 km) yields min I_2ph = 1.51 kA. Breaker 12.5 kA is the smallest standard rating above 9.30 × 1.1 = 10.23 kA. Relay pickup 600 A lies between load margin 360 × 1.25 = 450 A and sensitivity limit 1508/2 = 754 A.
